correctedFindings: ADR012-F001: the HXX position classifier now closes ordinary, URL, nested-document, URL-list, namespace, raw-child, event, style, and non-literal positions with source-positioned compile failures.
ADR012-F002: one Haxe-generated native-runtime plan is consumed by the PHP, WordPress, Genes, and React sink probes and verified by digest.
ADR012-F003: CompilerMarkup has a private constructor accessible only to the exact generated fragment class and carries fragment identity plus Haxe source provenance.
ADR012-F004: typed JSON codecs execute before the sink and retain either encoded JSON or an explicit failure result.
ADR012-F005: InlineStyle and Stylesheet have distinct typed ASTs, printers, and final-sink rules.
ADR012-F006: custom KSES policies have a canonical tag, attribute, and protocol document bound to their identity by SHA-256.
ADR012-F007: the browser and WordPress probes consume adversarial URL matrices and reject raw string event and rich-HTML paths.
ADR012-F008: the Genes identity is derived from the immutable browser dependency lock and recorded consistently as 1.38.0.
ADR012-F009: non-retention is stated as an enforceable SDK API policy, not as a linear-type guarantee.

limitations: The Haxe output types and sinks are a bounded architecture prototype, not the SDK-052 public implementation.
The closed HXX position classifier and native-runtime plan are bounded architecture prototypes; the generic-PHP/WordPress production lowerers are not implemented by this receipt.
The prototype implements a typed custom KSES policy constructor; a production public constructor and browser rich-HTML policy are not implemented by this receipt.
Browser rich-HTML policy, PHP 7.4, packed-consumer, and provider-markup behavior are not tested by this receipt.
The unsafe raw target is intentionally withheld until ADR-019 defines auditable waiver governance.
The corrected commit has hosted evidence and still needs a fresh independent Oracle rereview.
